summary.intent: Execute all plans for GSD phase 68.1 (web client runtime integration) using wave-based parallel subagent execution, verify the phase goal, then plan and execute a gap-closure round after real e2e/manual testing surfaced bugs the automated executors missed.
summary.outcome: All 14 original plans plus 8 gap-closure plans (15-22) executed across multiple waves with worktree isolation; e2e failures dropped from a 6/208 baseline through 17→13→8-ish failing groups as real bugs (folder-store id desync, kind-cache not wired into UI components, text-editor decryption using the wrong key, missing IPNS TEE-republish enrollment, SHARE-WRITE-KEY gap) were found and fixed, but the final exit-gate plan (68.1-22) was interrupted by an account session-limit and required manual recovery of uncommitted test-fixture fixes before the phase could be closed out.

repo: mock-ipns-routing dev container stores IPNS records in an in-memory Map — any container restart wipes it; only records enrolled in the API's ipns_records DB row/republish schedule survive restarts.
API dev server listens on :3000; :3001 is the separate delegated-routing mock (DELEGATED_ROUTING_URL target for web-e2e) — easy to conflate when probing health.
mock-ipns-routing's healthcheck used `wget localhost`, which resolves to ::1 while the app binds IPv4-only, causing a perpetual false-unhealthy status; fix is `wget 127.0.0.1` in docker-compose.yml.

Migration 1750000000000-ApiSchemaCutover dropped the shares table's plaintext item_name column entirely (not renamed), making the REQ-4 itemName backfill feature permanently dead code (share.service.ts hardcodes itemName: '') — reviving it would violate the project's zero-knowledge rule.
gsd-tools decision-coverage gate only recognizes an informational tag when placed inside the bold ID group, e.g. `- **D-04 [informational]:**`, not elsewhere in the line.

Serial (describe.serial) Playwright specs abort at first failure, so 'N failed / 208 passed' understates real breakage — most failing groups die in setup, leaving deep coverage (e.g. text-editor decrypt, version download) never executed even when the suite is 'green'.

code.finding: downloadFromIpns fed the parent folder's folderKey into sdk-core's resolveFileMetadata instead of the file's own readKey (both are Uint8Array so the type system didn't catch it) — caused AEAD 'decryption failed' in the text editor and likely VersionHistory downloads; fixed by recovering the file readKey via unsealChildReadKey before the call (commit de2807ec8).

isFolder was hardcoded to true, so the D-02 kind cache populated in 68.1-14 was never consulted in the shared browser — every shared item rendered/behaved as a folder until 68.1-15 wired isFolder = !isFileRef(item).

fetchShareKeys/fetchPendingRotations/updateSharePermission threw instead of failing closed, and createShare was dead code; 68.1-20 made them fail-closed to [] / no-op and populated writeDescriptorRef on toReceivedShare to unblock SHARE-WRITE-KEY wiring.

createFolder originally published child IPNS records without encryptedIpnsPrivateKey/keyEpoch, so subfolders were never enrolled in TEE republish (ipns_republish_schedule stayed empty) — a real production durability gap where subfolder records would die at the 48h IPNS TTL; fixed in 68.1-16 with a RED→GREEN TDD pair.

makeUploadResult test fixture repeatedly drifted from the evolving contract (missing fileNodeId/fileReadKey/fileWriteKey after 227abb6c7, then non-UUID node ids, then a mock needing mockOnce) — required three rounds of fixture-only fixes across two sessions to get 19/19 passing again.

workflow: Wave-based execution with git worktrees works well for file-disjoint plans, but agent-reported worktree_metadata.expected_base can be wrong (68.1-21 reported its own docs commit as the base instead of the true fork point) — verify the fork base independently before merging.

Background subagents driving long-running processes (e.g. a 25-min Playwright suite) can lose their wake-up/completion signal after the run finishes, leaving them parked indefinitely; arm an independent watchdog (poll for the result artifact) and use SendMessage to resume the agent's session directly rather than re-spawning fresh.
When an agent hits the account session-limit mid-task, its uncommitted work must be manually inspected, validated (build/tests/typecheck), and committed — don't assume the task is lost.
Live progress into a background-captured Playwright run can be read directly from the bash task's stdout capture file when the normal fd/pipe inspection doesn't reveal a target.

friction: Wave 1's first executor agent stalled mid-stream after 119 tool calls / ~23 min, requiring a manual spot-check and background resume before it completed.

The exit-gate agent's background e2e run completion was 'lost' (agent never re-woke) on at least two separate occasions, requiring manual detection via process/artifact liveness checks and SendMessage resumption.
Session hit the account usage limit during the exit-gate agent's final closeout, killing it mid-task and requiring manual recovery of its uncommitted fixture fixes.
Transient git index.lock during Wave 3 tracking commit required a retry.
Bash permission was denied when trying to read a file that likely touched .env, requiring the command to be split.

One gap-closure agent (68.1-16) mistakenly ran a prohibited `git stash push` and had to manually reapply the reverted edit rather than using the also-prohibited `git stash pop`, leaving a stray stash entry to clean up.
Decision-coverage gate initially rejected an [informational] tag due to placement outside the bold ID group, requiring source investigation of the parser logic.

User's real hands-on testing (logout/login navigation, text editor decrypt) repeatedly surfaced bugs the automated e2e suite structurally couldn't reach because serial specs abort before those code paths execute.
open_items: Old files uploaded before the fileReadKey seal fix have permanently mis-sealed parent refs and will still fail to decrypt in the text editor — data damage in the dev vault, not a code bug, needs manual re-upload to verify the fix.
conflict-detection e2e spec still fails at the same point even after the 'adopt published state after publish' fix.
sharing-workflow e2e failure at re-wrapping verification still needs triage.
enumerateSharedSubtree (shared-move destination picker) still returns an empty list because it's built on the now-empty share_keys fan-out — documented follow-up gap, not yet fixed.
rotation-durability SC-4 e2e failure not yet resolved.

GAP-6 (REQ-4 itemName backfill dead code post-schema-cutover) intentionally left undecided — needs a product decision (reintroduce plaintext storage vs. formally retire the feature) rather than a unilateral code fix.
recovery IPFS-direct v2-blob e2e failure remains an expected/documented residual.

Phase 68.1 exit-gate plan (68.1-22) closeout — final SUMMARY, tracking updates, and gsd-verifier round 2 — was not yet completed when the session was interrupted; recovery/commit of the closeout work was in progress at transcript end.
